text.EN: You did? What happened after that?
text.TL: Talaga? Ano ang nangyari pagkatapos noon?

text.EN: How did you manage to get through it?
text.TL: Paano mo nagawang malusutan iyon?

text.EN: Did anyone else make it out with you?
text.TL: May iba pa bang nakaligtas kasama mo?

text.EN: Where did you go once that went down?
text.TL: Saan ka pumunta nang mangyari iyon?

text.EN: What made you think of that just now?
text.TL: Bakit mo biglang naisip iyon ngayon?

text.EN: How long ago was that?
text.TL: Gaano na katagal mula noon?

text.EN: Were there many casualties back then?
text.TL: Marami bang nasawi noong panahong iyon?

text.EN: What did you end up doing about it?
text.TL: Ano ang naging aksyon mo tungkol doon?

text.EN: That sounds intense. What came next?
text.TL: Matindi 'yon. Ano ang sumunod?

text.EN: Did you ever go back to that place?
text.TL: Bumalik ka pa ba sa lugar na iyon kailanman?

text.EN: Really? Tell me more about that.
text.TL: Talaga? Kuwento mo pa sa akin.

text.EN: That sounds like quite a memory. How did it feel?
text.TL: Mukhang napakagandang alaala. Anong naramdaman mo?

text.EN: I'd love to hear the rest of that story if you want to share.
text.TL: Gusto kong marinig ang karugtong ng kuwento kung nais mong ibahagi.

text.EN: It must have taken real courage. How did you hold up?
text.TL: Kailangan ng tunay na tapang doon. Paano mo kinaya?

text.EN: You went through so much. I'm glad you're here to talk about it.
text.TL: Napakalaki ng pinagdaanan mo. Mabuti at narito ka para ikuwento.

text.EN: Were you able to save anything from back then?
text.TL: May naisalba ka ba mula noong panahong iyon?

text.EN: I'm listening, friend. Take all the time you need.
text.TL: Nakikinig ako, kaibigan. Huwag kang magmadali.

text.EN: That sounds like someone who mattered deeply to you.
text.TL: Mukhang may taong napakahalaga sa 'yo sa kuwentong 'yan.

text.EN: What a journey. What kept you holding on?
text.TL: Napakalaking paglalakbay. Ano ang nagpatatag sa 'yo?

text.EN: Thank you for trusting me with that memory. What happened next?
text.TL: Salamat sa pagtitiwala sa akin ng alaalang 'yan. Ano sumunod?

text.EN: And then?
text.TL: Tapos?

text.EN: What happened?
text.TL: Anong nangyari?

text.EN: After that?
text.TL: Pagkatapos?

text.EN: How so?
text.TL: Paano?

text.EN: Who survived?
text.TL: Sinong nakaligtas?

text.EN: When?
text.TL: Kailan?

text.EN: Outcome?
text.TL: Kinahinatnan?

text.EN: Next?
text.TL: Kasunod?

text.EN: Details?
text.TL: Mga detalye?

text.EN: End result?
text.TL: Huling resulta?

text.EN: Why are you telling me that?
text.TL: Bakit mo sinasabi sa akin iyan?

text.EN: What's the point of bringing that up now?
text.TL: Anong layunin sa pagbubukas niyan ngayon?

text.EN: Are you testing my reaction?
text.TL: Sinusubukan mo ba ang magiging reaksyon ko?

text.EN: Who else knows about that story?
text.TL: Sino pa ang nakakaalam ng kuwentong 'yan?

text.EN: Why share something so personal with me?
text.TL: Bakit mo ibinabahagi ang ganyang personal na bagay sa akin?

text.EN: Sounds like an angle. What do you really want?
text.TL: Mukhang may pakay ka. Ano ba talaga ang gusto mo?

text.EN: Does that story have anything to do with our safety here?
text.TL: May kinalaman ba ang kuwentong 'yan sa kaligtasan natin dito?

text.EN: Be careful what details you hand out to people.
text.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa mga detalyeng ipinamamahagi mo sa iba.

text.EN: Are you trying to gauge where my loyalties lie?
text.TL: Sinusubukan mo bang alamin kung kanino ako tapat?

text.EN: Keep your personal history to yourself.
text.TL: Itago mo na lang sa sarili mo ang sarili mong nakaraan.
